jurisdiction_name: ALABAMA SIMPLIFIED SELLERS USE TAX (SSUT) PROGRAM
code_system: ALDOR SSUT (statewide flat; no locality code)
notes: Act 2015-448 / Code of Ala. 40-23-193(a): eligible remote sellers (no AL physical presence) approved into the program collect a flat 8% on ALL sales into Alabama regardless of locality; relieves seller and buyer of all other state and local sales/use tax on the transaction; no locality coding on the return; local share distributed by ALDOR by population. Must apply and be accepted BEFORE collecting; filed electronically in My Alabama Taxes by the 20th monthly; 2% discount on first $400,000 of tax (max $8,000/month). Marketplace facilitators collect SSUT on marketplace sales.

notes: NO state or local sales/use tax to collect (Division of Revenue: "Delaware does not impose a state or local sales tax"). Instead a gross receipts tax (license fee) is imposed on the SELLER for goods sold within DE and is not a tax collected from buyers: Retailer rate 0.7468% of monthly aggregate gross receipts less a $100,000 monthly deduction ($300,000 quarterly for quarterly filers) per 30 Del. C. s.2905(b) (https://delcode.delaware.gov/title30/c029/index.html); retailer business license $75 + $25 per branch. Division of Revenue license/business code for "Retailer - General" = 396 (DoR rate list https://revenuefiles.delaware.gov/docs/gr_rates.pdf, dated 2016). DoR "Tax Tips for General Retailers" PDF shows 0.7543% - older/conflicting; statute text (0.7468%) governs. A remote seller with no DE license/presence generally has nothing to file; GRT is not owed on goods the retailer delivers to customers outside DE. Confirm DE nexus facts before registering.

Returns: G-45 (periodic) and G-49 (annual), Rev. 2025 forms for periods beginning on/after 2026-01-01. All four counties levy a 0.5% county surcharge on 4%-rate activities, so every retail sale sourced to Hawaii is 4.5% (max visible pass-on 4.7120%). Paper G-45/G-49 Part V and Form G-75 identify districts by NAME (Oahu/Maui/Hawaii/Kauai ovals and columns); numeric district codes 1-4 are used on Schedule GE. Sales of tangible personal property are sourced to where delivered.

jurisdiction_name: Oahu Taxation District (City and County of Honolulu)
notes: Oahu county surcharge 0.5% effective 2007-01-01 through 2030-12-31. G-45/G-49 Part IV line 19; G-75 Column a. District code per Schedule GE instructions ('Oahu enter 1; Maui enter 2; Hawaii enter 3; Kauai enter 4'); surcharge rates/dates per https://tax.hawaii.gov/geninfo/countysurcharge/. Surcharge applies only to 4%-rate activities. Remote seller: sales assigned to a surcharge district where the seller lacks nexus in that district are exempt from the surcharge (ED Code 109).

Maui county surcharge 0.5% effective 2024-01-01 through 2030-12-31 (in force as of 2026-09-15 per DOTAX county surcharge page). Covers islands of Maui, Lanai and Molokai. Sales to Kalawao County are NOT subject to the surcharge (Schedule GE ED Code 159). G-45/G-49 Part IV line 20; G-75 Column b. District code per Schedule GE instructions ('Oahu enter 1; Maui enter 2; Hawaii enter 3; Kauai enter 4'); surcharge rates/dates per https://tax.hawaii.gov/geninfo/countysurcharge/. Surcharge applies only to 4%-rate activities. Remote seller: sales assigned to a surcharge district where the seller lacks nexus in that district are exempt from the surcharge (ED Code 109).

Hawaii county surcharge 0.5% effective 2020-01-01 through 2030-12-31 (was 0.25% during 2019). G-45/G-49 Part IV line 21; G-75 Column c. District code per Schedule GE instructions ('Oahu enter 1; Maui enter 2; Hawaii enter 3; Kauai enter 4'); surcharge rates/dates per https://tax.hawaii.gov/geninfo/countysurcharge/. Surcharge applies only to 4%-rate activities. Remote seller: sales assigned to a surcharge district where the seller lacks nexus in that district are exempt from the surcharge (ED Code 109).

Kauai county surcharge 0.5% effective 2019-01-01 through 2030-12-31. G-45/G-49 Part IV line 22; G-75 Column d. District code per Schedule GE instructions ('Oahu enter 1; Maui enter 2; Hawaii enter 3; Kauai enter 4'); surcharge rates/dates per https://tax.hawaii.gov/geninfo/countysurcharge/. Surcharge applies only to 4%-rate activities. Remote seller: sales assigned to a surcharge district where the seller lacks nexus in that district are exempt from the surcharge (ED Code 109).

notes: Resort-city local option sales tax (Idaho Code Title 50 Ch. 10). NOT administered by the Idaho State Tax Commission - ISTC says to contact the city directly; ISTC publishes no code or rate.
